fingerprintAlgorithm.encoding: UTF-8 compact JSON, no spaces, declaration order below, excluding fingerprint

generationRule: Report authority binds exact current registration generation; held reservations remain charged to physical pool across generation changes until released.

occupancySemantics.reportedInflight: worker-measured outstanding state admission units retained by queued, executing or unconfirmed physical work; caller/transport termination cannot retire them; absent means unknown and grants no usable native capacity
occupancySemantics.gatewayHeld: child gateway held reservations, with unknown overlap against worker reported occupancy
occupancySemantics.parentHeld: parent adds its own held reservations conservatively; never infer overlap
occupancySemantics.physicalMetrics: reportedInflight state admission units only, without clipping away retained work debt; not a forward-pass/thread/resource-utilization count; conservative routing occupancy stays distinct

requestCost.batch: min(number of states, selected pool maxConcurrency)

physicalLifetime.undispatchedWork: retire only after all owned queued work is removed before backend dispatch
physicalLifetime.callerReservation: may end independently; releases only its own parent-held reservation once
physicalLifetime.physicalPermit: queued and executing work retain ownership independently of caller lifetime; an unconfirmed dispatched operation retains debt until an authoritative completion or checked process exit
physicalLifetime.incarnationFence: fence exact process/pool incarnation from dispatch through classification, checked termination and debt retirement; old completion must not release new work
